answer.overall: The contract meets the policy on payment terms and renewal, but is missing a liability cap and public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: The Supplier will invoice monthly in arrears. The Customer will pay each invoice within 30 days of receiving it.
findings.note: Payment is due 30 days after the invoice is received, as the policy asks.
The contract does not limit the supplier's liability.
The contract does not require the supplier to hold public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: At the end of the initial term it renews automatically for successive periods of 12 months; either party may stop it renewing by giving at least 90 days' written notice before the end of the initial term or of any renewal period.
findings.note: It renews automatically, and the customer can stop it with 90 days' notice, within the policy's three months.
Nothing in the contract shows the supplier handling personal data.
